**No, the evidence shows no deforestation on this asset after 2020.**

- No tree-cover loss event of 0.5 ha or more was detected after the 31 Dec 2020 baseline. The annual Hansen series runs through 2025 with full data coverage.
- The only post-baseline loss was 0.4 ha in 2021, in patches below the 0.5 ha minimum, so it is not counted as an event.
- The JRC 2020 reference shows 0
